text: In St. Cloud, parents challenged James Baldwin's Giovanni's Room, which was used in an eleventh- and twelfth-grade elective English class, alleging that it promoted promiscuity and bisexuality and conflicted with their religious beliefs. After a formal complaint, a review committee voted to retain the book in the curriculum. In Russia, the publisher AST said it would stop selling Giovanni's Room after an expert review found that it violated Russia's expanded ban on "gay propaganda".
